name: reel-time
description: Reel Time: /fish opens the cozy fishing game, /reel-time:lake points it at your own lake; when Claude finishes, a bell rings and a golden fish bites.

gameUrl.title: Game URL
gameUrl.description: Where Reel Time opens. Usually left empty: /reel-time:lake <your lake link> sets it.

artifactUrl.title: Artifact URL
artifactUrl.description: The lake that receives the 'Claude is working / done' signal. Usually left empty: /reel-time:lake sets it.

signalGame.title: Signal the game
signalGame.description: Tell the game when Claude starts and finishes, so a golden fish bites when your answer is ready.

alwaysOn.title: Always on
alwaysOn.description: Signal and ring every session, without running /fish first.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Ring after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Only ring the bell for turns that took at least this long.

bell.title: Ring a bell
bell.description: Play a small bell when Claude finishes a turn.
